k-vice.title: GTA VI Vice City BAWSAQ coins
k-vice.sourceSays: Posts say $BAWSAQ is a Vice City stock-exchange meme inspired by GTA's fictional market, with a site where users launch GTA6 coins; one account calls an earlier BAWSAQ contract a bundled scam.
k-vice.reason: Posts of Nov 9-13 describe the GTA-market concept and a launch site, ahead of the GTA VI release; claims are unverified and one post disputes it.

k-grand.reason: Many fresh GTI copycat pools (0.2h old) with only project self-promo and call posts; GTA VI hype exists but nothing ties these coins to it. Recheck later.
